title: Potential resource leak
detail: The generator `self.gen` is closed in the `__exit__` method. If the generator is not properly closed, it could lead to resource leaks.

title: Unhandled StopIteration in generator throw
detail: If the generator `self.gen` raises a `StopIteration` exception when `throw()` is called, it is caught and handled. However, the exception might not be properly re-raised in all cases, potentially masking errors.

title: Test case duplication
detail: The test case `foo(a # fmt: skip )bar(b # fmt: skip )` is duplicated multiple times in the test file. This increases the test execution time and makes it harder to maintain.
